title.narrative: Program for Asia Connectivity and Trade MultiDonor Trust Fund

description.narrative: "The objective of the trust fund is to improve pro-poor connectivity infrastructure and policy reforms in targeted sectors of regional cooperation and sub-regions of PACT Countries (as defined below), with the longer-term goal to contribute to increasing levels of trade and investment, reducing cost of sustainable energy, and enhancing resilience through strengthened cooperative management of shared natural resources in PACT Countries."
